F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b): link prep with g copies in R2, U_E as 4 phases on L2, per-corner CX+CCX (CZ.CX merged, CS^dag + rccx), r folded into the R2 slots, sector height h_b by a flip-invariant 3-way rccx mux whose selectors also give K1=[r=101] and z=[r=000], tau removed by plain CX(h_X->e1) before a relative-phase 2-control H, closed-pair GHZ gadget; bright flag = NOR of 4 rccx-folded e1 plus z & e2=1111 for the closed pair; one 8-term Gray-cycle uniformly controlled Rz on F (8 CX); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F2 explicit direction qubit: link prep, g-controlled canonicaliser + Bell map at corners c0/c2, direction f = [x0=g_b][x10=g_t] in one Toffoli, f-controlled lowering at c1/c3, c0/c2 partner fix, then a 6-term Walsh multiplexer on f over four good-equal-corner bits plus kappa=1 and closed-pair gadgets; all angles are integer (closed: sqrt2) multiples of beta.

exact degree-1 spectral transform of a flat dilation of W = prod_c K_c (F4): corner-local Dicke frame (pseudo-spin chain e1 -> S -> e3 made classical, U_E as 4 free phases), direction qubit q = f(data), q-controlled corner-local lowering J so both members of every bright pair share the data register, then one class-multiplexed Rx on q gated by AND_c[corner is a raising source and not dark]; closed chain via q=|+> on the all-Q loop plus an A<->L toggle.

frame D (link prep, corner CX/CCX/C2H, GHZ fold of the Q flags; U_E = 4 phases on the flags) sends 80 bright pairs to basis pairs; per r-class (7) merged Toffolis make partners differ only in F=q1, a 4-7 literal rccx AND (shared invariant prefixes) flags the class and one crx(-2 kappa s beta) rotates it; closed pair by an unconditional CX.CH.H basis change and one crx; then D^dagger.

F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b), parent r01-F1-001 with the closed-pair flag Y4 = z & [e2=1111] removed: frame (link prep, U_E on L2, corner CX+CCX, r in R2 slots, h_b mux with K1/z selectors, CX tau fix before relative-phase CCH, deltas, closed GHZ gadget) and the four rccx folds + NOR ladder X1 as in the parent; the uniformly controlled Rz on F now reads y = Y3 = [e2=1111] directly with 10 Gray-cycle Walsh terms over (x, k, z, y) instead of 8 terms + one rccx pair (-4 CX, one ancilla fewer); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F2 round 2 on the F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b; corner CX+CCX, 3-way rccx mux for the sector height h_b = direction XOR F, CX tau fix, relative-phase CCH, closed GHZ gadget, 4 rccx folds + NOR bright flag x) with the closed-pair flag cut to y = [e2 = 1111] (3 rccx, no z factor): a 10-term uniformly controlled Rz on F over (x, K1, z, y) walked in 10 CX replaces the 8-term cycle over (x, K1, z, z&y), saving one mirrored rccx (net -4 CX, 9 ancillas); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F3 controlled partner involution, no canonicaliser: light frame (L2 = Q flag, U_E as 4 phases on L2; R2 slots as h_b / r_t / r_l / r_r^r_l registers; h_b by two in-place rccx Fredkin halves + one Toffoli into the raw R2 of link b; one CX per corner; tau fix CX(h_X -> e1); 4 relative-phase C2H; e1 ^= g^delta^1 with one CX per corner; closed gadget H(q3), CCH(Z,F), rccx) makes the partner map the involution Pi = X_F Q, Q = prod_c X^(!e2_c) on e1_c, with every one of the 81 couplings +1 (closed -1); exp(i theta Pi) = cQ exp(i theta X_F) cQ (Hadamard-test identity with the flip qubit F as the test qubit), cQ = 4 S-conjugated rccx(F, !e2, e1); bright flag = AND of 4 in-place corner tests delta_c ^ (e2 & e1) plus two kappa=1 folds; 10-term Gray-path Walsh rotation on F over (X, Z, r_t, r_r^r_l); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F4 flat direction-qubit dilation (parent r01-F4-001) with relative-phase Toffolis made exact by gauges: corner Dicke frame with a 4-CX relative-phase C2H and an rccx+CS species relabel, direction q = NAND of the a^b test at the two opposite corners c0, c2 (one ccx), q-controlled lowering s1 ^= q !t2 s2 as three rccx per corner plus an S(s1) frame gauge, exact all-source/not-dark test (8-literal rccx chain) and class-multiplexed Rx on q (kappa=2 angle sign flipped to absorb the C2H control phases); closed chain via q=|+> on the loop plus an A<->L toggle.

F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b), parent r02-F1-002 with the fold/NOR flag X1 and the closed-pair check Y1..Y3 replaced by one exact bright test: frame as in the parent (link prep, U_E on L2, corner CX+CCX, r in R2 slots, h_b mux with K1/z selectors, CX tau fix, relative-phase CCH, deltas, closed GHZ gadget; the c3 test literal e1 ^ delta_c3 merged into the tau fix at no cost); flag x = AND_c [e1_c = 0 and (e2_c or delta_c)], closed pair included, from three in-place quadratic tests on the delta registers (delta ^ e2 & !(e1 ^ delta)), corner c2 as the literal !e1 before and after one in-place fold, and a 5-input rccx chain (26 CX per side instead of 30); the uniformly controlled Rz on F needs only 6 Gray-cycle Walsh terms over (x, K1, z); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F3 controlled partner involution in CH form (parent r02-F3-001): light frame (L2 = Q flag, U_E as 4 phases on L2; h_b by two in-place rccx Fredkin halves + a Margolus Toffoli with a CZ(h_b, r.L1) gauge into the raw R2 of link b; one CX per corner; tau fix CX(h_X -> e1); 4 relative-phase C2H; ONE kappa=1 dark-label fold rccx(e1c3, !e2c3 -> F) onto the flip qubit itself (no fold ancilla); e1 ^= g^delta^1; closed gadget H(q3), CCH(Z,F), rccx) maps every pair to labels related by Pi = X_F Q, Q = prod_c X^(!e2_c) Z^(e2_c) on e1_c, with the same coupling sign for all 80 open pairs; exp(i theta Pi) = W exp(i theta X_F Z_E) W, W = 4 CH(!e2 -> e1) (1 CX each), Z_E folded into the Gray path by 4 CX(e1 -> F) at each end; bright flag = AND of 4 in-place corner tests delta_c ^ (e2 & e1); 10-term class-signed Walsh rotation on F over (X, Z, r_t, r_r^r_l); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F4 flat direction-qubit dilation (parent r02-F4-002) with a cross-corner sector frame and ancilla-free lowering: per corner (a, b, c, w) = (s1, s1^s2, s1^t1, s2^t2) by 3 CX, the target-end Q flag read from the neighbouring corner's b (b_{c-1} = t1^t2 on valid codes) as the second control of the 4-CX relative-phase C2H, rccx+CS species relabel; class flags e = [g_b=g_t][g_r=g_l], k0 = e [g_t=g_l] from the four b's; direction q = NAND(a^b at c0, c2) by one rccx with Z/S gauges; q-controlled lowering a ^= q b_c b_{c-1} as one Maslov RC3X^dag (6 CX, no ancilla) with S(a), T(b_{c-1}) gauges, then b ^= q (CY); exact all-source/not-dark test (8-literal rccx chain, dark = (c, w) = 0) and class-multiplexed Rx on q; closed chain via q=|+> on the loop plus an A<->L toggle; all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F1 round 4 on the F3 controlled-partner frame (parent r03-F3-002) with the class selector of the F1 line: frame, CH partner W Z_E W, single dark-label fold onto F, Margolus+CZ h_b Toffoli, 4 relative-phase C2H, closed gadget and the AND of 4 in-place corner tests as in the parent, but the closed-sector flag is built as Z = P & !r_l from the selector P = [r_t = 0 and r_r = r_l] = rccx(!r_t, !(r_r ^ r_l)) (same 6 CX as the delta chain it replaces), so the class-signed angle psi(P, Z) = -2, -1, 4 sqrt2 needs 3 Walsh terms instead of 5: the rotation on F is 6 Gray-cycle terms over (X, P, Z) instead of 10 (-4 CX, -4 rotations); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F3 controlled partner involution in CH form with a kappa selector (parent r03-F3-002): frame as in the parent (L2 = Q flag, U_E as 4 phases on L2; h_b by two in-place rccx Fredkin halves + a Margolus Toffoli with a CZ(h_b, r.L1) gauge; one CX per corner; tau fix CX(h_X -> e1); 4 relative-phase C2H; one kappa=1 dark-label fold rccx(e1c3, !e2c3 -> F); e1 ^= g^delta^1; closed gadget H(q3), CCH(Z,F), rccx), but the intermediate of the closed selector is now U = [r_t = 0 = r_r^r_l] (kappa=1 class or closed) from rccx(!r_t, !r_rl) and Z = rccx(U, !r_l) = [r = 000] (same 6 CX as before); exp(i theta Pi) = W exp(i theta X_F Z_E) W, W = 4 CH(!e2 -> e1), Z_E folded into the Gray path by 4 CX(e1 -> F) at each end; bright flag X = AND of 4 in-place corner tests delta_c ^ (e2 & e1); the Walsh rotation on F needs only 6 Gray-cycle terms over (X, U, Z) instead of 10 over (X, Z, r_t, r_rl) (4 CX and 4 rotations fewer); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F4 flat direction-qubit dilation, parent r03-F4-003 unchanged except the bright test: the 8 literals (P_c = a^b, notdark_c = c or w per corner) are ANDed in a balanced rccx tree (4 + 2 + 1, same 7 rccx and 21 CX) instead of a linear chain, lowering the depth at equal CX and T; frame (3-CX cross-corner sector frame, 4-CX relative C2H, rccx+CS relabel), class flags e, k0, direction q = NAND(P_c0, P_c2), Maslov RC3X^dag lowering + CY, class-multiplexed Rx on q and the closed A<->L toggle as in the parent; all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.
